subject: Next steps: SOC 2 status, VPC isolation options & questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Walsh <tom.walsh@medfusion.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap — security, SOC 2, deployment options

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary:
- MedFusion is evaluating a private deployment (VPC with optional air-gapped staging) for PHI workloads.
- Key compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected cert by Q4 2026), HIPAA contractual language required, GDPR data residency for EU cases.
- Primary concerns: network isolation diagrams, proof of SOC 2 scope & timelines, vendor questionnaire for infosec team.

Immediate next steps (what we'll do):
1) We will send our vendor security questionnaire (short form) for your infosec to complete. Ben will own this.
2) We'll attach a lightweight VPC diagram template and a gap-playbook PDF that maps common evidence items to where MedFusion can find them.
3) Karthik to schedule a technical deep-dive to validate air-gap feasibility (30–45 min).

Request for you:
- Please share the current SOC 2 timeline + any existing evidence your legal/security team can surface (e.g., scoping doc, audit firm name).
- Indicate whether EU data is expected by contract (GDPR residency) or if a pseudonymization approach is acceptable.

I'll drop the questionnaire and a diagram stub in a follow-up. If this looks good, can we tentatively schedule the tech deep-dive on Monday 2026-05-11?

Thanks,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-gap-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
Attachment: vpc-draft-diagram.png (PNG, 120KB)
From: Tom Walsh <tom.walsh@medfusion.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@medfusion.com
Date: 2026-05-04T09:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap — security, SOC 2, deployment options

Thanks, Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We started scoping in Jan 2026, audit fieldwork is planned for late Sep. We don't have Type II yet; Type I was completed in 2025 but scope was limited. I can share the scoping spreadsheet (sensitive) with your team under an NDA.

2) HIPAA: Yes, we need to see Business Associate Agreement language and a high-level description of where PHI is stored/processed. That will sit with our Legal ops.

3) GDPR: We expect to onboard a small EU pilot in Q3; at minimum we need data residency for training datasets and a data processing addendum. Pseudonymization is acceptable for some flows, but not for core clinical identifiers.

Technical note: air-gapped staging is a hard requirement for a subset of customers. We'll need a short checklist from you describing egress controls and how model updates are handled in an air-gapped setup.

Can Ben send the questionnaire to security@medfusion.com? Also please mark anything labeled "sensitive" before sharing.

Tom
CTO, MedFusion Health
Attachment: medfusion-soc2-scope.xlsx (XLSX, 58KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Tom's replies. Action items for Redwood: 

- Ben: prepare and send concise vendor security questionnaire to security@medfusion.com (aim for <25 items; include SOC 2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, network segmentation, data residency, incident response, BAA readiness). Attachments: redwood-gap-playbook-v1.pdf and vpc-draft-diagram.png. Please flag any Qs that require legal review.

- Karthik: draft a 30–45 minute tech deep-dive agenda focused on air-gap capabilities, model update process, and KV cache/local storage. Proposed slots: 2026-05-11 14:00–14:45 PT or 2026-05-12 10:00–10:45 PT.

Thread notes: Tom asked for NDA for scoping docs — coordinate with Legal if needed. Also they require a BAA sample.

Thanks — Steph

Subject: Vendor security questionnaire + VPC diagram template (MedFusion)

Tom — attaching a concise questionnaire and a VPC diagram template as discussed. I've annotated the questionnaire where we typically expect evidence (e.g., control owner, evidence file). A couple notes up front: 

- SOC 2 items: mark question 4 as "in progress" if you only have scoping; we can accept a scoping doc + auditor name for initial review.
- BAA: we included a sample BAA clause you can share with Legal; if you prefer, our Sales Legal can run a short redline.
- Air-gap checklist: see section 7 — covers egress controls, offline model update procedures, and verification steps we run during onboarding.

Attachments: medfusion-sq-v1.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB), vpc-draft-diagram.png (PNG, 120KB)

- You review and return medfusion-sq-v1.xlsx to security@medfusion.com.
- Karthik to confirm a tech deep-dive slot; I've penciled in 2026-05-11 14:00 PT.

If anything is sensitive, reply with a note and we'll switch to the NDA path.

Best,
Ben Carter
